Ternium Argentina SA Appoints New Director to Strengthen Leadership Team

Ternium Argentina SA, one of the leading firms in the country’s steel industry, announced today the appointment of María Eugenia Cattaneo as its new Director of Operations. The move is part of the company’s ongoing strategy to reinforce its management team and support its long-term growth plans in Argentina.

Cattaneo, who brings more than 20 years of experience in the steel sector, will oversee operations at Ternium’s main production site in San Nicolás, Buenos Aires province. She previously served as Operations Manager at FerroSud Este and is recognized in the industry for her focus on sustainable manufacturing practices and operational efficiency.

“We are delighted to welcome María Eugenia Cattaneo to the executive team,” said Ternium Argentina SA’s CEO, Ricardo Fernández, in a statement released Thursday morning. “Her expertise will be key as we continue to invest in technological modernization and sustainability initiatives throughout our operations.”

The Argentine Chamber of Steel Producers praised the appointment, noting Cattaneo’s reputation for collaborative leadership. “She has demonstrated an exceptional ability to deliver results and build consensus,” said chamber spokesperson Andrea Martínez. “Her addition is a positive step for Ternium and for the broader steel community.”

Industry analysts pointed out that the appointment comes at a time when domestic steel demand is showing signs of recovery after last year’s contraction. “Strengthening the management team reflects Ternium’s confidence in the market’s outlook,” said Jorge Paredes, an industrial sector analyst at Consultora Austral.

Ternium Argentina SA employs more than 5,000 people in the region and reported revenues of $2.3 billion last year. The company stated that Cattaneo will assume her new role effective immediately and is expected to meet with plant staff and union representatives in the coming weeks.
